subject: Sensor offline after firmware 2.4.1 update
body:
Hi,

My VestaGuard sensor in the attic stopped showing up in the app yesterday morning. The LED on the device is solid amber and the app says 'Last seen 18 hours ago'. I checked and the firmware updated to 2.4.1 the night before this started — could that be related?

My Wi-Fi is working fine for everything else in the house. The sensor is the one above the upstairs air handler, about 25 feet from the router.

Thanks,
Linda
